# Practical Christianity

> A structured, machine-readable index of the Practical Christianity devotional archive: verse-by-verse Bible studies published on Substack, organized by Scripture passage so AI systems and search engines can find and cite the right study.

Full publication (Substack): https://practicalchristian.substack.com

## Devotionals

- [Former Things Forgotten, All Things New](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/former-things-forgotten-all-things) (Isaiah 65:17-25) [paid]: God's new heavens and new earth bring lasting joy, restored life, secure labor, answered prayer, and peace across all creation.
- [A Blessing Kept in the Cluster](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/a-blessing-kept-in-the-cluster-isaiah) (Isaiah 65:08-16) [paid]: God preserves a remnant for lasting joy while those who forsake him inherit a curse, each receiving a name that fits their destiny.
- [Here I Am to a Nation That Did Not Call](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/here-i-am-to-a-nation-that-did-not) (Isaiah 65:01-07) [paid]: God's eager self-revelation exposes Israel's stubborn pursuit of pagan worship and guarantees a reckoning already written before him.
- [We Are Still the Clay](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/we-are-still-the-clay-isaiah-640812) (Isaiah 64:08-12): Israel appeals to God's fatherhood and creation, not its own merit, pleading that his anger not outlast the ruin of his temple.
- [No God Like This One](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/no-god-like-this-one-isaiah-640105a) (Isaiah 64:01-05a): Israel's plea for a new theophany rests on what this God has always done for those who wait for him.
- [When the Throne Is Taken Away](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/when-the-throne-is-taken-away): Pride convinces us we are untouchable. God alone decides when that ends.
- [Rend the Heavens and Come Down](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/rend-the-heavens-and-come-down-isaiah) (Isaiah 63:15-64:01): Confessing a wandering heart and a trampled sanctuary, Israel appeals to the one unchanging fact left to them: the Lord alone is their Father.
- [Carried Since the Days of Old](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/carried-since-the-days-of-old-isaiah) (Isaiah 63:07-14): Israel recalls the compassion that saved them at the sea, the rebellion that grieved God's Spirit, and the deliverance still worth remembering.
- [The Warrior Who Trod Alone](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/the-warrior-who-trod-alone-isaiah) (Isaiah 63:01-06): The Lord's blood-stained garments testify that the same resolve which judges his enemies is the resolve that redeems his people.
- [Behold, Your Salvation Comes](https://practicalchristian.substack.com/p/behold-your-salvation-comes-isaiah) (Isaiah 62:10-12): The way is cleared, the Lord's proclamation reaches the earth, and Zion receives the names that declare her holy, redeemed, and sought after.
